title: skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/skeleton.md.j2 and templates/skeleton.html.j2. Field names match content/02-output-contract.xml; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

suite_id.title: Suite id
suite_id.description: What kebab-case id names this suite, prefixed ff- (e.g. ff-billing-service)?

suite_owner.title: Suite owner
suite_owner.description: Who is accountable for the whole suite, as role:handle (e.g. arch:alice)? Not a team alias.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Which layers or module groups does the architecture declare, in order from outermost to innermost (e.g. api, domain, persistence)?

allowed_edges.title: Allowed edges
allowed_edges.description: Which dependency directions are allowed between those layers, as from->to pairs (e.g. api->domain, domain->persistence)?

results_store_location.title: Results store location
results_store_location.description: Where does every run's measured value land — a metrics backend series, a CI artifact path, or a committed CSV?

retention_days.title: Retention days
retention_days.description: How many days is the results series kept? At least the review horizon: 30 for monthly, 90 for quarterly.

cadence.title: Review cadence
cadence.description: How often is the suite reviewed against its trend data — monthly or quarterly?

function_id.title: Function id
function_id.description: What kebab-case id names this fitness function (e.g. layer-direction)?

characteristic.title: Characteristic
characteristic.description: Which single architectural characteristic does this function guard, as a noun phrase with its scope (e.g. afferent coupling of billing.core)? Not an -ility adjective.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: What unit is the metric measured in (ms, violations, functions, percent)?

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Which category of characteristic is this — structural, complexity, performance, coverage, delivery, security or operability?

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Is this function run by a tool in CI (automated) or assessed by a person at a cadence (manual)?

tool_name.title: Tool
tool_name.description: Which tool measures it (ArchUnit, NetArchTest, dependency-cruiser, import-linter, lizard, k6)?

command.title: Command
command.description: What exact command does CI run for this function, verbatim?

threshold_operator.title: Threshold operator
threshold_operator.description: How does the measured value compare to the threshold to pass — <, <=, >, >= or ==?

threshold_value.title: Threshold value
threshold_value.description: What numeric limit, in the stated unit, must the measured value satisfy?

baseline_value.title: Baseline value
baseline_value.description: What did the command measure on the current main branch when the function was written?

baseline_date.title: Baseline date
baseline_date.description: On which date was the baseline measured, as YYYY-MM-DD?

threshold_mode.title: Threshold mode
threshold_mode.description: Does the function fail against the absolute threshold today, or only when the value gets worse than the baseline (ratchet)?

consequence.title: Consequence
consequence.description: Does a red result block the merge or deploy (blocking) or only report (informational)?

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: Does it run on every change (triggered) or on a schedule or in production (continual)?

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Is it a sub-minute check of one thing (atomic) or an expensive whole-system run such as a load test (holistic)? Holistic functions are continual.

function_owner.title: Function owner
function_owner.description: Who is accountable for this function, as role:handle?
